# CRE features in LCL by accessibilituy

**How often does a read carry a FIRE element at GM12878 cCREs? How does this differ between active cCREs and low-DNase cCREs?**

1. active CRE: every element not labelled Low-DNase (129,266). These have high DNase signal in GM12878 and keep their GM12878 class (PLS, pELS, dELS, CA-CTCF, CA-TF, CA-H3K4me3, CA-only)
2. low_dnase_cre: elements labelled Low-DNase (2,219,588). These are cCREs active in some other cell type but not in GM12878



```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  fig.path = file.path(tempdir(), "cre-access-figures/"))
```

Region files and per-read BEDs are generated by `cre_fire_freq_dnase.sh`.
Counting and chromosome combination are separate, explicit jobs in
`count_cre_fire_frequency.R` (use `--test` for chr21 and the first sample).
This notebook only reads existing `fire_freq.<set>.tsv` count tables and writes
summaries and plots. It never counts reads or overwrites the count tables.
With `params$test = TRUE`, it reads the existing tables in `test_chr21/`.

```{r load_packages}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table); library(ggplot2)})
out_root <- Sys.getenv("CRE_ACCESS_ROOT", "/project/spott/cshan/fiber-seq/LCL_project/CRE_access")
region_dir <- file.path(out_root, "regions")
sample_sheet <- "/project/spott/1_Shared_projects/LCL_Fiber_seq/Data/LCL_sample_metatable_merged_samples_31samples.csv"
run_dir <- if (params$test) file.path(out_root, "test_chr21") else out_root
sets <- c("active_cre", "low_dnase_cre")
chroms <- if (params$test) "chr21" else c(paste0("chr", 1:22), "chrX", "chrY")
samples <- fread(sample_sheet)$sample_name
if (params$test) samples <- samples[1]
```

# Read and validate existing counts

`n_reads` counts covered fibers; `n_fire` counts covered fibers with an overlapping
FIRE element. Before plotting, check all expected region IDs and coordinates,
sample columns, nonnegative integer counts, pooled totals, and FIRE frequencies.
Missing or incomplete tables stop the report; they do not trigger counting.

```{r read_counts}
count_files <- setNames(file.path(run_dir, sprintf("fire_freq.%s.tsv", sets)), sets)
missing_counts <- count_files[file.access(count_files, 4L) != 0L]
if (length(missing_counts))
  stop("Missing or unreadable count tables: ", paste(missing_counts, collapse = ", "),
       ". Run count_cre_fire_frequency.R separately to generate them.")
tabs <- setNames(lapply(count_files, fread), sets)
count_checks <- list()
for (s in sets) {
  x <- tabs[[s]]
  nr <- paste0("n_reads_", samples); nf <- paste0("n_fire_", samples)
  required <- c("chrom", "start", "end", "id", "class", "n_reads", "n_fire", "fire_freq", nr, nf)
  if (!all(required %in% names(x))) stop(s, ": missing columns: ", paste(setdiff(required, names(x)), collapse = ", "))
  if (!setequal(grep("^n_reads_", names(x), value = TRUE), nr) ||
      !setequal(grep("^n_fire_", names(x), value = TRUE), nf)) stop(s, ": sample columns differ from manifest")
  bed <- fread(file.path(region_dir, paste0(s, ".bed")), header = FALSE, select = c(1:4, 10),
               col.names = c("chrom", "start", "end", "id", "class"))
  bed <- bed[chrom %in% chroms]
  if (anyNA(x$id) || anyDuplicated(x$id) || anyDuplicated(bed$id)) stop(s, ": missing or duplicate region IDs")
  missing_ids <- setdiff(bed$id, x$id); extra_ids <- setdiff(x$id, bed$id)
  if (length(missing_ids) || length(extra_ids))
    stop(s, ": incomplete region coverage: ", length(missing_ids), " missing, ", length(extra_ids),
         " unexpected IDs. Missing examples: ", paste(head(missing_ids), collapse = ", "))
  expected <- bed[match(x$id, id)]
  for (column in c("chrom", "start", "end", "class"))
    if (anyNA(x[[column]]) || !all(x[[column]] == expected[[column]])) stop(s, ": region metadata differs: ", column)
  for (column in c("n_reads", "n_fire", nr, nf)) {
    values <- x[[column]]
    if (!is.numeric(values) || anyNA(values) || any(!is.finite(values) | values < 0 | values %% 1 != 0))
      stop(s, ": invalid counts in ", column)
  }
  for (i in seq_along(nr))
    if (any(x[[nf[i]]] > x[[nr[i]]])) stop(s, ": n_fire exceeds n_reads for ", samples[i])
  if (any(x$n_fire > x$n_reads) || any(x$n_reads != rowSums(x[, ..nr])) ||
      any(x$n_fire != rowSums(x[, ..nf]))) stop(s, ": invalid pooled counts")
  positive <- x$n_reads > 0
  if (!is.numeric(x$fire_freq) || any(!is.na(x$fire_freq[!positive])) ||
      anyNA(x$fire_freq[positive]) ||
      any(abs(x$fire_freq[positive] - x$n_fire[positive] / x$n_reads[positive]) > 1e-10))
    stop(s, ": invalid FIRE frequencies")
  count_checks[[s]] <- data.table(set = s, regions = nrow(x), samples = length(samples),
                                  chromosomes = uniqueN(x$chrom))
}
print(rbindlist(count_checks))
rm(x, bed, expected)
```

# Step 4: summary

Summary of per-read FIRE frequency by region set (and by cCRE class within
active_cre), ECDF by set, and between-sample correlation; written to
`<run_dir>/summary/`.

```{r load_tables}
out_dir <- file.path(run_dir, "summary")
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
min_reads <- 10

cat(sprintf("Samples (%d): %s\n\n", length(samples), paste(samples, collapse = ", ")))

for (s in sets) {
  x <- tabs[[s]]
  bad <- x[n_fire > n_reads, .N] +
    sum(sapply(samples, function(k) sum(x[[paste0("n_fire_", k)]] > x[[paste0("n_reads_", k)]])))
  cat(sprintf("%-20s n_fire > n_reads violations (pooled + per sample): %d\n", s, bad))
}
```

## FIRE frequency by region set and cCRE class

```{r summary_table}
# median and fraction > 0.1 use regions with >= min_reads covering reads; pooled uses every region
stats <- function(n_reads, n_fire, fire_freq) {
  ok <- n_reads >= min_reads
  list(n_regions = length(n_reads), n_reads_ge10 = sum(ok), median_n_reads = as.numeric(median(n_reads)),
       median_fire_freq = median(fire_freq[ok]), pooled_fire_freq = sum(n_fire) / sum(n_reads),
       frac_fire_freq_gt_0.1 = mean(fire_freq[ok] > 0.1))
}
by_set <- rbindlist(lapply(sets, function(s)
  tabs[[s]][, c(list(set = s, class = "all"), stats(n_reads, n_fire, fire_freq))]))
by_class <- tabs$active_cre[, c(list(set = "active_cre"), stats(n_reads, n_fire, fire_freq)), by = class]
summary_dt <- rbind(by_set, by_class[order(-n_regions)], use.names = TRUE)
fwrite(summary_dt, file.path(out_dir, "fire_freq_summary.tsv"), sep = "\t")
cat("\nFIRE frequency summary (median / frac > 0.1 over regions with n_reads >= 10):\n")
print(summary_dt[, lapply(.SD, function(v) if (is.double(v)) signif(v, 3) else v)], row.names = FALSE)
```

## ECDF

```{r ecdf, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 4.5}
ecdf_dt <- rbindlist(lapply(sets, function(s) tabs[[s]][n_reads >= min_reads, .(set = s, fire_freq)]))
n_ok <- ecdf_dt[, .N, by = set][match(sets, set), N]
ecdf_dt[, set := factor(set, levels = sets,
                        labels = sprintf("%s (n = %s)", sets, format(n_ok, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)))]
p <- ggplot(ecdf_dt, aes(fire_freq, colour = set)) +
  stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Per-read FIRE frequency (n_fire / n_reads)", y = "Fraction of regions",
       title = "Per-read FIRE frequency by region set",
       subtitle = sprintf("Regions with >= %d covering reads, pooled over %d sample(s)", min_reads, length(samples))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.98, 0.04), legend.justification = c(1, 0))
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "fire_freq_ecdf.pdf"), p, width = 6.5, height = 4.5)
p
```

## Histogram

Same regions as the ECDF; y = fraction of the set's regions per bin, with its
own y scale in each panel.

```{r histogram, fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 6}
h <- ggplot(ecdf_dt, aes(fire_freq, fill = set)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density * width)), binwidth = 0.02, boundary = 0,
                 colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~set, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Per-read FIRE frequency (n_fire / n_reads)", y = "Fraction of regions",
       title = "Per-read FIRE frequency by region set",
       subtitle = sprintf("Regions with >= %d covering reads, pooled over %d sample(s)\nbin width 0.02; y scale differs per panel",
                          min_reads, length(samples))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0))
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "fire_freq_histogram.pdf"), h, width = 6.5, height = 6)
h
```

## Between-sample correlation

```{r sample_correlation}
if (length(samples) > 1) {
  sample_pairs <- CJ(a = samples, b = samples)[a < b]
  cors <- rbindlist(lapply(sets, function(s) {
    x <- tabs[[s]]
    sample_pairs[, {
      ra <- x[[paste0("n_reads_", a)]]; rb <- x[[paste0("n_reads_", b)]]
      ok <- ra >= min_reads & rb >= min_reads
      fa <- x[[paste0("n_fire_", a)]][ok] / ra[ok]
      fb <- x[[paste0("n_fire_", b)]][ok] / rb[ok]
      list(set = s, n_regions = sum(ok), pearson = suppressWarnings(cor(fa, fb)),
           spearman = suppressWarnings(cor(fa, fb, method = "spearman")))
    }, by = .(a, b)]
  }))
  fwrite(cors, file.path(out_dir, "fire_freq_sample_correlation.tsv"), sep = "\t")
  cat(sprintf("\nBetween-sample correlation of fire_freq (regions with n_reads >= %d in both):\n", min_reads))
  print(cors[, .(n_pairs = .N, median_n_regions = median(n_regions),
                 pearson_median = median(pearson, na.rm = TRUE), pearson_min = min(pearson, na.rm = TRUE),
                 pearson_max = max(pearson, na.rm = TRUE), spearman_median = median(spearman, na.rm = TRUE)),
             by = set][, lapply(.SD, function(v) if (is.double(v)) signif(v, 3) else v)], row.names = FALSE)
}
cat(sprintf("\nWrote %s/{fire_freq_summary.tsv, fire_freq_ecdf.pdf, fire_freq_histogram.pdf%s}\n", out_dir,
            if (length(samples) > 1) ", fire_freq_sample_correlation.tsv" else ""))
```
